title: Mineral resources of the Wambaw Swamp Wilderness Study Area, Charleston County, South Carolina, with a section on oil and gas
citation: Cameron, C.C., Force, E.R., Gazdik, G.C., and Rodehamel, E.C., 1979, Mineral resources of the Wambaw Swamp Wilderness Study Area, Charleston County, South Carolina, with a section on oil and gas: U.S. Geological Survey Open-File Report OF-79-229, map scale 1:48,000.
notes: Auger-hole logs 1-10 (table 1, pages 13-25) give depths in meters with feet in parentheses; depths recorded in meters as printed. Fossil lists in the logs were summarized into the interval descriptions, not itemized. Some depth figures are garbled ('18*3', '13*1', '3.4^', '7-2.7' read as .7-2.7); those are flagged inferred. Hole 1 shells line reads 'at 3.5 m' within the 8.5-10.0 m interval (probably 8.5 m) and was left as printed in the quote. Figure 3 (Clubhouse Crossroads core column, page 10) and the plates (pages 39-40, OCR) are garbled and were not used except the Hfp label. Table 3 heavy minerals was not itemized. Map unit symbols on the plate OCR are garbled; unit names here are the text's map symbols. References on oil and gas/geophysics outside South Carolina were skipped.
